title: Why the Moon Looks Huge This Week

segments.text: On Tuesday, the Moon gets closer to Earth!
Its path around us isn't a circle. It's an oval.
At its farthest, the Moon is about 406,000 kilometers away.
But Tuesday's full Moon swings in to just 360,765 kilometers.
A full Moon this close is called a supermoon.
Next to the smallest full Moon, it looks up to 14% bigger… and 30% brighter!
The best time to look? Right as it rises, glowing low over the horizon.
And it's only the first. In December, it comes even closer, to 356,738 kilometers.
So on Tuesday, look up… the Moon is coming closer.
